name: East Manali / Hamta, Himachal Pradesh, India
processing: Decoded RGB to elevation metres before bilinear resampling from256x256 to128x128; rounded to nearest metre. Row0=north, column0=west. No smoothing, synthetic peaks or visual height exaggeration baked into data.
license: SRTM public-domain US government data; preserve USGS attribution and identify modifications. Dataset provider attribution documentation applies.
credit: Mapzen Terrain Tiles. SRTM terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
usage: Distant visual scenery only. Not playable terrain, navigation, survey data or an exact recreation of the driving course.
